sourceText: Continue development and remove the repeated wall-clock waste observed after B-8195, where quorum_submit left host-verdict metadata dirty and caused a later long validation to be rejected.
normalizedOutcome: A clean quorum_submit invocation leaves a clean repository with all six verdicts durably committed; any persistence failure leaves zero new verdicts and preserves HEAD and user bytes.
acceptanceClaim: On the real local CLI, quorum_submit either commits exactly the complete six-row current-round quorum and leaves git clean, or fails with complete rollback and no gate-countable partial quorum.
